rationale: The application is a data-dense betting simulator. It requires a 'Control Room' feel, prioritizing high-visibility data clarity, rapid scannability, and high-stakes performance styling.

rules: No generic sans like Inter for headings.
Use JetBrains Mono for all racing odds, liabilities, stakes, and P&L data.
Use Barlow Condensed for section headers and aggressive styling.
Use dense, compact spacing (`p-4`, `p-6`) for data cards.
1px solid strokes everywhere. No soft dropshadows. Use inner glows or solid borders for depth.
Grid children must stretch to match row height (`h-full`).

buttons.primary: bg-pink-600 hover:bg-pink-500 text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-none transition-colors border-b-2 border-pink-800 active:translate-y-[2px] active:border-b-0
buttons.secondary: bg-[#1C1C1C] hover:bg-[#2A2A2A] text-white border border-[#2A2A2A] rounded-none transition-colors

tables.header: bg-[#1C1C1C] text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400 border-b border-[#2A2A2A] p-3

inputs.default: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-[#2A2A2A] text-white p-2 focus:border-pink-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-pink-500 rounded-none font-mono

animations.micro_interactions: Hover states must lighten background and change text colors. Buttons have a tactile click (active:translate-y).
animations.data_updates: Use flash effects (green/red background pulse) when P&L updates.

image_urls.description: Abstract greyhound/dog aesthetic for login or empty states, use with heavy dark overlay (bg-black/80).

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the 'Control Room' grid system for layout. The dashboard should have a settings panel on the left/top and live race card/P&L in the center/right.
Data density is critical. Use Shadcn Table but customize it to have tight padding and no rounded corners.
Highlight Betfair 'Lay' actions clearly using the provided pink accents (#EC4899).
All monetary values and odds MUST use the `JetBrains Mono` font for perfect alignment.
Implement the strategy accurately: target the specific favourite that lost. Display the recovery level (1, 2, 3) visually, perhaps with segmented progress bars or badges.
Use Phosphor Icons (sharp/regular) for UI elements.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.
Maintain the dark 'Tactical Minimalism' vibe. Avoid large blocks of color; use color sparingly for data visualization (wins/losses).
